button.label: Kiểm tra kết nối
button.supertip: Xac thuc token + xem so dong inventory / master_data / shipping_forecast tren DB.

button.label: Nạp TagID và Bin
button.screentip: Lay du lieu NHAP KHO tu file nguon
button.supertip: Chon file nguon (Stock Balance With Batch) -> loc A=8/1220 VA B=01/60 -> ghi sheet TON_KHO (Tag ID, Bin).

button.label: Nạp Nguồn
button.screentip: Lay du lieu CAP NHAT NGUON tu file nguon
button.supertip: Chon file nguon -> chi loc A=8/1220 -> ghi sheet MASTER_DATA (Stock Code, Warehouse, CREATEDATE, BATCH, Qty; bo cot E - BIN).

button.label: Tìm WH Kế hoạch
button.screentip: Tim kho xuat (WH) tu PDF Packing List
button.supertip: Doi chieu PDF Packing List (Outlook hoac Thu muc) theo PO/SO, Product Code dong 1 va Pack Quantity -> dien cot WH (01, 60 hoac *=WH;*=WH) vao sheet KE_HOACH_XUAT_HANG.

button.label: Đẩy dữ liệu
button.supertip: Ghi THAT: thay the toan bo bang ton kho tren DB bang du lieu sheet TON_KHO.

button.label: Đẩy nguồn
button.screentip: Day CAP NHAT NGUON len DB (that)
button.supertip: Ghi THAT: thay the toan bo bang master_data tren DB bang du lieu sheet MASTER_DATA.

button.label: Đẩy kế hoạch
button.screentip: Day KE HOACH XUAT HANG len DB (that)
button.supertip: Ghi THAT: cong don ke hoach xuat hang (khong xoa du lieu cu) tu sheet KE_HOACH_XUAT_HANG.

button.label: Đẩy thử dữ liệu
button.supertip: Dry-run: chi dem so dong hop le, KHONG ghi du lieu.

button.label: Đẩy thử nguồn
button.screentip: Thu nghiem CAP NHAT NGUON (khong ghi)
button.supertip: Dry-run: chi dem so dong hop le, KHONG ghi du lieu.

button.label: Đẩy thử kế hoạch
button.screentip: Thu nghiem KE HOACH XUAT HANG (khong ghi)
button.supertip: Dry-run: chi dem so dong hop le, KHONG ghi du lieu.

button.label: Tải PDF Outlook
button.screentip: Tai toan bo PDF tu Outlook cua Hong Pham ve SynData (Backup)
button.supertip: Che do du phong (Backup): Quet va luu toan bo file PDF tu hop thu Outlook cua Hong Pham ve thu muc SynData de he thong doi chieu truc tiep tu o dia khi quet tu dong khong tim thay.
